jobs.title: VP / Head of E-commerce & Marketing – Paid Advisor
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a VP / Head of E-commerce & Marketing – Paid Advisor based in Canada.

We are seeking a strategic, commercially driven senior leader to oversee and accelerate e-commerce growth and digital marketing performance. This position requires a strong understanding of online business models, customer acquisition, and performance-driven marketing strategies. You will be responsible for developing and executing growth initiatives, optimizing digital sales channels, and maximizing return on marketing investments. Working in a results-oriented environment, you will combine strategic leadership with hands-on expertise to identify opportunities, improve conversion rates, and drive sustainable revenue growth. The role offers the opportunity to shape digital strategy, influence business performance, and contribute directly to the organization's long-term commercial success. The ideal candidate is an entrepreneurial leader with a strong track record of delivering measurable results across e-commerce and paid marketing.

Accountabilities

Define and lead the overall e-commerce and digital marketing strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and revenue targets.
Oversee the performance of online sales channels, identifying opportunities to improve customer acquisition, conversion rates, retention, and average order value.
Develop, implement, and optimize paid media strategies across relevant digital advertising platforms to maximize return on advertising spend (ROAS) and marketing investment.
Lead customer acquisition and growth initiatives, using data-driven insights to improve campaign performance and commercial outcomes.
Manage e-commerce operations and digital sales performance, ensuring a seamless customer journey across all online touchpoints.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including revenue, customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, lifetime value (LTV), and return on investment (ROI).
Identify emerging market trends, customer behaviors, and new growth opportunities to strengthen the organization's competitive position.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, technology, and operations, to ensure effective execution of growth initiatives.
Establish performance reporting frameworks and provide strategic recommendations to support data-driven decision-making.
Build, mentor, and lead high-performing e-commerce and marketing teams, fostering accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

Significant experience in senior leadership roles within e-commerce, digital marketing, growth marketing, or performance marketing.
Proven track record of developing and executing successful e-commerce and paid acquisition strategies that deliver measurable business growth.
Strong expertise in paid advertising platforms, campaign management, audience targeting, budget allocation, and performance optimization.
Demonstrated ability to manage substantial marketing budgets while maximizing ROAS, improving CAC, and driving profitable customer acquisition.
In-depth understanding of e-commerce platforms, digital sales funnels, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and customer lifecycle management.
Strong analytical and strategic capabilities, with experience using marketing analytics, attribution tools, and performance dashboards to guide decisions.
Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, managing stakeholders, and driving complex projects from strategy through execution.
Excellent communication, negotiation, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Commercially minded and highly results-oriented, with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable growth strategies.
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while balancing strategic priorities with hands-on execution.
Strong understanding of emerging digital marketing trends, e-commerce technologies, and evolving customer acquisition strategies.

Benefits

Senior leadership opportunity: Take ownership of e-commerce and digital marketing strategy, with direct influence on business growth and commercial performance.
Competitive compensation: Salary and overall package to be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated results.
Strategic impact: Play a key role in shaping the organization's digital growth roadmap and long-term commercial direction.
Professional development: Opportunity to expand leadership experience and contribute to innovative digital business initiatives.
Collaborative environment: Work with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders to deliver meaningful results.
Career growth: Opportunity to take on significant responsibilities within a strategic leadership position.
Work flexibility: Employment location based in India; specific remote or hybrid arrangements to be confirmed.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: Director - SR&ED Financing
jobs.description:
About us

R&D Financing is a fintech that advances capital to innovative Canadian companies against their SR&ED tax credit claims: non-dilutive funding, repaid when the refund arrives.

We're part of a global group that finances R&D in several countries, and we're now building our Canadian lending business from the ground up.

The role

This is a senior leadership role at the start of something new. As Director, SR&ED Lending, you'll build and run our lending across Canada: shape the offer, originate the first facilities, and turn Canada's SR&ED consultant community into a referral network that sends us deals, with the balance sheet and playbook of an established global R&D lender behind you.
Build the Canadian SR&ED lending book from day one: origination, underwriting input, portfolio growth
Win and manage relationships with SR&ED consultants and their clients as the primary channel
Represent R&D Financing in-market: events, partnerships, direct client conversations
Work with global leadership on pricing, risk and product, then adapt it to the Canadian market

Who we're looking for

7-10 years in the SR&ED market, ideally in consulting/claim preparation. You know the program, the players, and the client's pain cold
An entrepreneurial attitude. You want to build something and own the outcome, not inherit a desk; comfortable with ambiguity, strong bias to action
A diverse skill set. You move fluidly between relationship-building, commercial strategy, deal structuring, and hands-on execution
A strong network across Canada's innovation and advisory community (or the drive to build one fast)
Based in or near Vancouver; comfortable with hybrid work

What we offer

A founding leadership role with real ownership and upside
Hybrid working: a mix of in-person (Vancouver) and remote
Generous compensation, plus an equity/profit-share arrangement
